scope: Intentional source repairs, including the earlier helper repairs; historical manifest remains unchanged. All other pinned original paths must remain unchanged. Synthetic checks do not reproduce trained research accuracy.

utils/velocity.py.intent: Correct range-bin sampling and align Doppler/confidence with the existing projected nonzero-point mask.

utils/radar.py.intent: Normalize finite intensities by max-minus-min; map constant arrays to the lower palette endpoint.

dataloader/dataset.py.intent: Reject equal-count mismatched or empty paired frames; disable pickle; make valid/invalid masks complementary using finite positive in-range depth labels.

generate_dataset/numpy_to_trainset.py.intent: NumPy-only bounded deterministic conversion, paired stems, network elevation slice and existing-output protection.

generate_dataset/raw_dataset_to_numpy.py.intent: Source-relative import, bounded nearest-timestamp pairing with recorded offsets and output preservation.

utils/__init__.py.intent: Load optional ColoRadar tools lazily while retaining named re-exports.

utils/pairing.py.intent: Reject out-of-FOV returns, use nearest visible radius per pixel and accept NumPy arrays independently of Open3D.

train.py.intent: Use supplied optimizer; isolate train/eval modes, sample-weight metrics, keep evaluation remainder and support headless loss plotting.

eval.py.intent: Headless safe state_dict CPU evaluation, explicit optional viewer, paired raw frames, saved arrays/PLY and unmasked error metrics; preserve original two-class Softmax.

networks/DepthRefinement/network_parts.p.intent: Reject invalid depth labels and return differentiable zero when no valid depth observation exists, avoiding NaN without changing network architecture.
